context:
Pick taken by the orchestrator, Oct 28 07:45 CDT, without your answer: (c), keep hiding empty tiers. That is today's behaviour, a test pins it, and #770 (c122) ships it that way; c122's note drops the item. Reversible: say so and an empty line comes back as its own step.

Was asked: c122's note listed hidden empty tiers as a defect, while the page hides them on purpose.

options.gain: You always see all four tiers, so an empty one reads as empty, not missing.
options.how: Each empty tier shows its heading with a short 'Nothing here' line, in the list and in the overview rail.
options.label: Empty line in the list and the rail
options.lose: More lines on the page when little is waiting.

options.gain: The list reads as complete; the rail stays short.
options.how: The list shows each empty tier with a 'Nothing here' line; the rail keeps showing only tiers that have items.
options.label: Empty line in the list only
options.lose: The list and the rail show different sets of tiers.

options.gain: The shortest page; nothing to build.
options.how: No change; c122 drops the item from its note.
options.label: Keep hiding empty tiers
options.lose: An empty tier can look missing rather than empty.

ref: c122 (the waiting page shows what differs between options), c100 (the page's final look)
title: Should an empty tier on this page show a line saying it is empty?
